stations.title: Ffion
stations.say: Can the laptop add a request?
stations.note: Requests go on a paper pad now.

stations.title: Studio laptop
stations.text: Sends the song as plain text, with no label.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Takes song requests as JSON, and only JSON.

captions: Ffion wants the song requests listeners text her to go straight onto the list.
The laptop sends plain text with no label, and the cupboard server refuses it.
You send each request as JSON that says it is JSON, and read the answer, in three tasks.
Night Bus Home is on the list, with an id and an address of its own.
Data goes out in a body, and its content-type tells the server how to read it.
